snippet.title: Angels In Orbit (Announcement Trailer)
snippet.description:
This is not about saving the world, it’s about answering for it.

The year is 2170. An anomaly has ripped through the AIO Station, leaving a lone technician fighting to survive. As the silence of deep space closes in, biblical angels descend, beginning trials of morality, judgment, and the price of human ambition.

Genre: Existential sci‑fi horror, stealth survival mechanics, branching dialogue trees and multiple endings.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4042070/Angels_In_Orbit/
